lines.text: Israel took the land of the Amorite kings Sihon and Og, east of the Jordan, from the Arnon Valley to Mount Hermon.
The LORD made a covenant with Israel at Sinai and spoke face to face out of the fire, and Moses stood between them.
God commanded Israel to keep the Sabbath holy, laboring six days and resting on the seventh, along with servants and livestock.
The LORD spoke the commandments out of the fire to the whole assembly and wrote them on two tablets of bronze.
God told Moses to send the people back to their tents and to stand with Him to receive the commandments.
